pages_slug_check.name: pages_slug_check
pages_slug_check.value: "pages"."slug" = 'home' OR ("pages"."slug" = lower("pages"."slug") AND "pages"."slug" NOT GLOB '*[^a-z0-9-]*' AND length("pages"."slug") BETWEEN 1 AND 100)

editions_key_check.name: editions_key_check
editions_key_check.value: length("editions"."edition_key") BETWEEN 1 AND 100 AND "editions"."edition_key" = lower("editions"."edition_key") AND "editions"."edition_key" NOT GLOB '*[^a-z0-9-]*'

editions_interval_check.name: editions_interval_check
editions_interval_check.value: "editions"."start_at" IS NULL OR "editions"."end_at" IS NULL OR "editions"."end_at" > "editions"."start_at"

events_slug_check.name: events_slug_check
events_slug_check.value: length("events"."slug") BETWEEN 1 AND 100 AND "events"."slug" = lower("events"."slug") AND "events"."slug" NOT GLOB '*[^a-z0-9-]*'

invitations_acceptance_check.name: invitations_acceptance_check
invitations_acceptance_check.value: "invitations"."accepted_at" IS NULL OR ("invitations"."revoked_at" IS NULL AND "invitations"."accepted_at" <= "invitations"."expires_at")

media_assets_owner_check.name: media_assets_owner_check
media_assets_owner_check.value:
(
      ("media_assets"."owner_type" = 'organization' AND "media_assets"."owner_id" = "media_assets"."organization_id" AND "media_assets"."event_id" IS NULL AND "media_assets"."edition_id" IS NULL)
      OR ("media_assets"."owner_type" = 'event' AND "media_assets"."owner_id" = "media_assets"."event_id" AND "media_assets"."event_id" IS NOT NULL AND "media_assets"."edition_id" IS NULL)
      OR ("media_assets"."owner_type" = 'edition' AND "media_assets"."owner_id" = "media_assets"."edition_id" AND "media_assets"."edition_id" IS NOT NULL AND "media_assets"."event_id" IS NULL)
    )

organizations_slug_check.name: organizations_slug_check
organizations_slug_check.value: length("organizations"."slug") BETWEEN 1 AND 80 AND "organizations"."slug" = lower("organizations"."slug") AND "organizations"."slug" NOT GLOB '*[^a-z0-9-]*'
